milestones.label: Online application system opens on the CLEC site (2026 cycle)
milestones.source_text: Shanghai Jiao Tong University's page for this scholarship says the online application on chinese.cn became available from 1 March 2026; applicants also apply to the host university.

milestones.label: Application deadline depends on the host university and intake
milestones.source_text: Host universities set their own closing dates by intake. Zhejiang Gongshang University, for instance, lists 15 May 2026 for September 2026 starts and 31 October 2026 for March 2027 starts.
